blocks.text: One addition to Daniel's list, if I may. When you send the investor presentation, please include any questions that came up repeatedly in recent investor meetings, with a note of how your team answered them.

Questions of that kind are usually the clearest evidence of where the current description of the company leaves investors uncertain. We would like the findings to take them into account before any positioning language is drafted for {{fact:f:E-2017-001.client}}.
A short, informal list is entirely sufficient.
